## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project style and has the copyright header
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private data in the diff
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / docs / CHANGELOG) when behavior changes
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests or an explicit justification is given
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes
